semiconductor_relevance: High — AK Optics provides critical measurement and defect detection technologies essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: AK Optics Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor measurement technologies, focusing on defect detection and wafer measurement. Their products, such as the AMG-5000, offer advanced interferometric nanometrology for high-resolution wafer geometry measurement, and they provide defect detection systems for a variety of substrate types.
capabilities: AMG-5000 silicon wafer geometry measurement device
Defect detection systems for SiC, GaN, InP, GaAs, and glass substrates
Patterned and patternless wafer defect detection solutions
Optical thermometry and MOCVD in-situ monitoring systems
